tools.name: describe_business
tools.description: What Fluefold does, what happens to a request, and the request fields.

tools.name: submit_request
tools.description: Send a requirement to Fluefold. It is kept with a reference number. A request is recorded with a reference number. Fluefold will reconcile the site requirements, seek suitable provider scope and window options, and develop comparable nonbinding terms by email to the address left. No visits are booke

tools.name: request_status
tools.description: Resume a requirement using the receipt credentials. Read the recorded requirement and any linked offers. Contact details are kept apart.

tools.name: inspect_offer
tools.description: Read the exact authorized terms, terms hash, order state and processor payment links. Use the offer link credentials, or credentials of the request explicitly linked to this offer.

tools.name: accept_offer
tools.description: Place an order on terms you have inspected and the buyer has authorized you to accept. Requires the exact terms hash and explicit acceptance. Follow inspect_offer later for payment links and verified payment state.

tools.name: decline_offer
tools.description: Decline an issued offer on its inspected terms.

tools.name: release_payment
tools.description: Confirm a payment condition only where the inspected order allows the customer to release it. This records approval; it does not pay the processor.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "request_status" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
